title: 菊花賞の後に・見よ！キタサン祭り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black performs well at the Kikuka Sho. The fans were so enthralled with her running that Brusquement's absence went largely unnoticed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon seeing Kitasan Black's fantastic race, Sakura Bakushin O realizes her job as mentor is complete and takes leave of her role.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, as if resonating with and echoing Kitasan Black's incredible performance, Satono Diamond claims victory in her own debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's next goal is the Arima Kinen. In order to realize her dream of reuniting with Satono Diamond on that illustrious stage, she charges forth on her own.
